staticText: KCSE regular-candidate aggregate and mean-grade worksheet using Mathematics, the better of English or Kiswahili, and the best five remaining entered subjects, with the other language allowed among the remaining subjects. It shows every counted and excluded subject and maps the seven-subject aggregate to the official 7–84 mean-grade bands. It does not calculate KUCCPS weighted cluster points or predict programme or course eligibility; candidates must use official KNEC results and KUCCPS routes.
